updateContentCommand: if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; sed -i "s/^SECRET_KEY=$/SECRET_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)/" .env; fi && python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python manage.py migrate && .venv/bin/python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

postAttachCommand.server: if ! curl --silent --fail http://127.0.0.1:8000/login/ > /dev/null; then setsid -f sh -c 'exec .venv/bin/python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000 > /tmp/frota360-django.log 2>&1'; fi
